error_dropped_after_connect: No response from %1$s (disconnected right away). Check that the adapter or emulator is running.
error_waiting_for_vehicle: Waiting for the vehicle to respond
error_vehicle_gave_up: Disconnected because the vehicle did not respond
error_connect_gave_up: Gave up because the adapter could not be reached
error_reconnect_gave_up: Gave up reconnecting to the adapter
about_description: Records your drives with an OBD2 adapter and GPS and replays them on a map. Your location history stays on this phone.
summary_resume_within: Join trips across breaks up to %1$d min
adapters_description: Adapters you have connected to over BLE are remembered. When you open the app it connects to the last one. If you set up "Connect automatically when nearby", the app connects and starts recording when you start the engine and the adapter wakes up, even if the app is closed (if you have an adapter in each car, set up each one).
adapters_empty: None yet. Connect to a BLE adapter from "Connect" on the Meter tab.
adapter_name_hint: Leave empty to use the original name
idle_disconnect_description: The app stays connected this long after you turn off the engine, so if you restart it after a short stop, recording just continues. After that it disconnects so the adapter can go to sleep (longer means the adapter sleeps later).
reconnect_description: After the connection to the adapter drops, the app tries to reconnect every 5 seconds. If it cannot reconnect within this time it stops trying (so it does not keep using the battery after you leave the car).
auto_record_description: While connected to an adapter, recording starts when the engine starts (or the car moves) and stops after the car has been stopped for a while. It may not be able to start while the app is in the background.
auto_stop_label: Stop recording after being stopped for
resume_label: Join a trip across a break (e.g. at a rest area)
short_trip_description: When recording stops, trips shorter than this (such as when you connected but did not drive) are deleted. While a trip can still be continued after a break it is kept, and deleted if it is not continued.
disconnect_description: Even after you disconnect the adapter, recording can continue with GPS only.
confirm_gps_only_title: Confirm before recording without an adapter
confirm_gps_only_description: When you press "Start recording" without an adapter connected, the app asks whether to record with GPS only.
theme_description: "System default" follows the dark theme setting of your phone.
language_description: The language of this app. "Phone language" follows the language set on your phone.
units_description: Changes only how values are shown. Recorded data and exported files (CSV, KML) always use metric units.
vehicles_description: Trips and the meter layout are kept per vehicle. When you connect to an adapter, the app identifies the vehicle from its VIN (if available) and the adapter, and switches to it. The engine displacement is used to estimate fuel economy from intake pressure on cars that do not report mass air flow (MAF); it is not needed for cars with MAF.
vehicle_delete_text: The meter layout will also be deleted. This cannot be undone, so export a backup first if you need one.
vehicle_copy_layout: The meter layout starts as a copy of the vehicle you are using now.
vehicle_displacement_label: Displacement (cc, only for cars without MAF)
vehicle_delete_recording: You can't delete a vehicle while recording. Stop recording and try again.
events_description: Thresholds for the events shown on the trip map and replay. Changes also apply to past trips.
events_sharp_turn_label: Sharp turn (lateral G at %1$s or faster)
events_shock_label: Impact (a bump, going over a curb, etc.)
events_shock_description: Detected from shaking measured by the phone's accelerometer (low 1.0 G, medium 1.5 G, high 2.0 G). Mount the phone in a holder. With "Off" the shaking is not recorded, so impacts will not appear for those trips even if you change the level later.
places_description: Starts and destinations within %1$s of a saved place are shown with its name without looking up the address (so the location of your home etc. is not sent anywhere). Add places with "Save as place" on a trip.
live_address_switch: Show the current address on the meter
live_address_description: Shows the address when you put "Location" on the meter. While it is shown, the coordinates of your current position are sent to the OS address lookup (Google on Android) about once a minute (when you have moved 200 m or more). Nothing is sent inside saved places.
backup_description: Settings, saved places and meter layouts are included in your phone's Google backup automatically (when it is turned on in the phone settings). Trip data is too large to be included. Export it to a file with the button below and save it to Google Drive or elsewhere. It contains location data, so handle it with care.
backup_import_recording: You can't restore while recording. Stop recording and try again.
debug_description: Shows a screen with detailed connection and recording state, all values and supported PIDs, plus sample counts on trip details (for testing).
debug_addresses_refetched: Addresses will be looked up again
protocol_note: If the car does not respond with the selected protocol, the app falls back to automatic detection.
engine_ecu_only_note: For cars where replies from other ECUs get mixed in and values look wrong (CAN 11 bit only; sends to 7E0).
mini_switch: Show a mini window when leaving the app
mini_description: While recording (or while connected if automatic recording is off), the meter shrinks to a small window when you go to the home screen or another app. Drag it to move it; tap it to return.
mini_items: Items (up to %1$d, in the order selected)
mini_blocked: Picture-in-picture is turned off for this app in the system settings.
auto_backup_description: Writes the same file as "Export trip data" to the folder you choose on a schedule. If you choose a folder of a cloud app (such as OneDrive or Dropbox), that app uploads it. Not done while recording (it runs later).
auto_backup_wifi_note: For cloud folders, the cloud app decides when to upload.
auto_backup_keep_note: 0 keeps all backups. Only files created by this app are deleted.

backup_import_text.one: Your current trip data and settings will be replaced with the backup (%1$d trip). This cannot be undone, so export your current data first if you need it. The app restarts after restoring.
backup_import_text.other: Your current trip data and settings will be replaced with the backup (%1$d trips). This cannot be undone, so export your current data first if you need it. The app restarts after restoring.

page_delete_text: All items on the page will be deleted too.
stop_recording_too_text: Even after you disconnect the adapter, recording can continue with GPS only (vehicle data is not recorded).
tcp_hint:
PC emulator over USB with adb reverse: 127.0.0.1:35000
Wi-Fi adapters are often 192.168.0.10:35000
location_permission_needed: Recording needs permission for precise location
gps_only_text: No adapter is connected, so vehicle data such as speed and RPM will not be recorded. Once an adapter connects, vehicle data is recorded too.
recording_auto_hint: Auto recording: starts when the engine starts
recording_gps_hint: You can record with GPS only, without OBD
dont_show_again_recording: Don't show again (you can change this in Settings > Recording)
address_off: Turn on in Settings to show
prompt_unknown_vin: VIN %1$s. Which vehicle is it? Recording as "%2$s" for now.
prompt_new_adapter: Which vehicle do you use "%1$s" with? Once you choose, the app switches to that vehicle automatically next time. Recording as "%2$s" for now.
prompt_shared_adapter: "%1$s" is used with more than one vehicle. Recording as "%2$s". Choose another if that is wrong.
vstats_description: Calculated from the trips of the current vehicle. Averages are per trip. The items are shared by all vehicles.
item_address_note: While it is shown, the coordinates of your current position are sent to the OS address lookup (Google on Android) about once a minute (when you have moved 200 m or more). Nothing is sent inside saved places. You can also change this in Settings.
item_no_gauge: This value cannot be shown as a gauge
item_correction_note: Shown value = value × factor + offset. Applied before converting units (to the metric value), and only to the display; warnings use the original value.
item_center_note: When off, the value is shown small below
item_move_hint: To move an item, long-press it while editing and drag it to another cell
warn_note: The frame and background flash in the warning color when the value is at or below / at or above the threshold (uses the original value)
warn_sound_note: Plays once when the warning starts (while the meter is shown)
warn_sound_volume: Plays at alarm volume (even in silent mode)
metric_list_hint: After you connect to an adapter, values this car cannot provide can no longer be selected.
metric_address_hint: Turn on in Settings to show (sends coordinates to the address lookup)
metric_no_economy: Cannot be estimated for this car (for cars without MAF, enter the displacement in Settings)
trips_empty_text: Recording starts automatically when you connect to an adapter and start the engine. To record with GPS only, without an adapter, use "Start recording" on the Meter tab.
export_kml_open: Open KML in Google Earth etc.
no_gps_text: If recording starts while the app is in the background, GPS may not be recorded (it is recorded after you tap "Record GPS too" in the notification or open the app). The map and replay are not available, but vehicle data has been recorded.
rename_hint: Leave empty to remove the name
place_register_note: Starts and destinations within %1$s are shown with this name without looking up the address.
replay_estimated: GPS was lost in this section (position is estimated)
notice_recording_no_gps_text: The route is not being recorded. Open the app or tap "Record GPS too" to record it.
notice_waiting_text: Waiting for the vehicle to respond (start the engine)
notice_reconnecting_text: Once connected, recording starts when you start the engine
notice_connected_text: Recording starts when you start the engine
auto_record_background: Could not start recording automatically because the app is in the background. It starts when you open the app.
companion_registered: Set up. The app connects automatically when the adapter is nearby.
backup_not_ours: This is not a CarReplotter backup
backup_too_new: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app and try again.
downloads_save_failed: Cannot save to the Downloads folder
ble_connected_note: Connected to %1$s. Adapters that are connected are not shown in the scan.
ble_searching:
Searching…
Plug the adapter into the car and turn the ignition on.
ob_welcome_body: An app that records your drives with an OBD2 adapter and GPS and replays them on a map.
ob_welcome_auto: Recording starts automatically when you start the engine and stops when you stop
ob_welcome_replay: Replay your drives on a map and see events such as hard acceleration and sharp turns
ob_welcome_privacy: Where you drove (the GPS track) never leaves this phone. Only showing the map and the addresses of starts and destinations tells the map provider and the OS address lookup about a location.
ob_display_body: Choose the language, theme and units. You can change them later in Settings > Interface.
ob_location_body: Precise location is used to record your route. It is used only while recording, and recordings are stored on this phone.
ob_nearby_body: Used to find and connect to a Bluetooth OBD2 adapter.
ob_notifications_body: Shows a notification while recording or connected (Android requires a notification to keep recording in the background).
ob_done_body: You can check the connection and recording status on the Meter screen. You can change settings at any time.
ob_done_vehicle: Change the vehicle name and displacement in Settings > Vehicle management
ob_done_adapters: If you have an adapter in each car, connect to and set up each one
ob_adapter_body: Plug the adapter into the car's OBD2 port (often under the dashboard on the driver's side), start the engine, then search.
ob_adapter_wifi: Wi-Fi adapters can be connected from "Connect" on the Meter screen.
ob_adapter_registered: This adapter is set up for "Connect automatically when nearby". Recording starts when you start the engine, even without opening the app.
ob_adapter_register_body: If you set up "Connect automatically when nearby", the app connects and starts recording when you start the engine and the adapter wakes up, even without opening the app. Choose the adapter on the system screen.
ob_battery_body: While recording or connected, the app keeps running in the background with a notification. Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, which can cut a recording short. If recordings stop unexpectedly, set battery usage for this app to "Unrestricted".
ob_battery_usage: Battery use: the app talks to the adapter and uses GPS only while connected or recording. After the car has been stopped for a while it disconnects, so the adapter can sleep.
ob_mini_body: While recording, the meter shrinks to a small window when you switch to another app such as navigation. It shows speed, trip distance and trip time (you can change them in Settings > Interface).
ob_backup_body: Trip data stays on this phone. To be safe if you lose or replace your phone, the app can save a backup to a folder you choose (on this phone or in a cloud app such as Google Drive) on a schedule. You can set this up later in Settings > Backup.
ob_backup_choose: Choose a folder and turn on
